blocking_items.title: Model Training
blocking_items.description: baseline_r0 trained for only 3 epochs (mAP50=0.13). Requires 50+ epochs on GPU for usable detections. All 222 evaluation results are INCONCLUSIVE due to zero detections.

blocking_items.action_required: Train model for 50+ epochs on GPU, then re-run: python scripts/scenarios/34_evaluate_scenario_clips.py --scenario all --model <new_model_path>
